title: The EU AI Act just changed everything for tech companies

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The EU AI Act doesn't change anything—it just enforces existing global protocols like GDPR and ISO/IEC 23894.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: It introduces strict new requirements, like mandatory risk assessments for AI systems, which global companies now must follow.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: But major tech firms already use risk-mitigation frameworks—this just adds bureaucracy without real technical benefit.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: The Act mandates transparency in AI decision-making, something even leading US companies haven’t fully implemented.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The EU AI Act sets a global standard—ignore it, and you’ll be left behind as the rest of the world adapts.
